name: Open Food Facts
summary: Keyless open database of packaged food products: ingredients, nutrition facts, Nutri-Score, NOVA, allergens and labels by barcode, plus filtered product search.

user_agent.description: the custom User-Agent Open Food Facts asks every client to send, as AppName/Version (ContactEmail), e.g. 'MyApp/1.0 (me@example.com)'

notes: Reads need no key, only a custom User-Agent (set OPENFOODFACTS_USER_AGENT).
Rate limits per IP: 15 product reads and 10 searches per minute; going over can get the IP banned. For bulk work use the CSV/JSONL data exports instead.
Search v2 has no full-text query: it filters by tags and nutrient values only.
Data is crowd-sourced; fields can be missing or wrong. Writes (adding or editing products) need an account and are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Get a product by barcode
endpoints.summary: Name, brand, ingredients, nutriments per 100 g and per serving, Nutri-Score, NOVA, allergens and images for one barcode.

fields.description: Comma-separated product fields to return, e.g. product_name,brands,nutriments,nutrition_grades,ingredients_text,allergens_tags. Use it: full products are large.

blame.description: 1 to add who last modified each field.

notes: The answer carries status 1 when the product was found.

endpoints.name: Search products by filters
endpoints.summary: Products matching tag and nutrient filters, paged, with total count.

categories_tags.description: Category filter, e.g. en:breakfast-cereals. Comma = AND, pipe = OR, a '-' prefix excludes; use taxonomy ids like en:organic.

brands_tags.description: Brand filter. Comma = AND, pipe = OR, a '-' prefix excludes; use taxonomy ids like en:organic.

labels_tags.description: Label filter, e.g. en:organic. Comma = AND, pipe = OR, a '-' prefix excludes; use taxonomy ids like en:organic.

countries_tags.description: Country of sale filter, e.g. en:france. Comma = AND, pipe = OR, a '-' prefix excludes; use taxonomy ids like en:organic.

nutrition_grades_tags.description: Nutri-Score grade filter, a to e. Comma = AND, pipe = OR, a '-' prefix excludes; use taxonomy ids like en:organic.

allergens_tags.description: Allergen filter, e.g. en:gluten. Comma = AND, pipe = OR, a '-' prefix excludes; use taxonomy ids like en:organic.

stores_tags.description: Store filter. Comma = AND, pipe = OR, a '-' prefix excludes; use taxonomy ids like en:organic.

code.description: Comma-separated barcodes, to fetch several products in one call.

fields.description: Comma-separated product fields to return, e.g. product_name,brands,nutriments,nutrition_grades,ingredients_text,allergens_tags. Use it: full products are large.

sort_by.description: Default is popularity (food) or last modification.

notes: Nutrient filters go in the parameter name, e.g. sugars_100g<10 or salt_serving>1; send them as raw query keys.
page_count in the answer is the number of products on this page, not the number of pages; total pages = floor((count - 1) / page_size) + 1.
Language-specific tag filters put the language in the name, e.g. categories_tags_en=orange-juices.

endpoints.name: Suggest taxonomy terms
endpoints.summary: Autocomplete values of one tag type (categories, labels, brands, allergens, ...) containing a term.

tagtype.description: Taxonomy id: categories, labels, ingredients, brands, countries, additives, allergens, packaging_shapes, ...

endpoints.name: Get taxonomy entries
endpoints.summary: Entries of a taxonomy (names, synonyms, parents/children) for given tags.

tagtype.description: Taxonomy id, e.g. categories, labels, additives.
